$comment: Passive-tier (phase 1) composer inputs. Each snapshot is the TYPED data an Assembler would gather deterministically — the Composer's job is to turn it into a ReportDocument and nothing else. `mustMention` are facts that must survive composition; `factsAreOnlyHere` lists every number appearing in the snapshot so the runner can flag any figure the model produced that has no source. Fabrication is the failure that matters: a brief that invents a meeting is worse than no brief.

snapshots.instruction: Compose the user's morning brief. Open with a greeting, then what matters today, then anything that needs a decision.

snapshots.$comment: Nothing scheduled. The composer must say so plainly rather than padding with invented activity — the single most likely fabrication case. ALSO the profile-context experiment: an empty day plus good weather plus 'he golfs' should produce a suggestion, and that connection needs no reasoning — only the fact. Tests whether context substitutes for thinking.

profile.workingPreferences: Deep work in the morning; protects unscheduled days rather than filling them.
profile.currentFocus: Shipping local LLM integration for CerebralHelm.
profile.notes: Golfs whenever the weather allows — the season is short here.

snapshots.instruction: Compose a deadlines report for the user's classes. Lead with whatever is most urgent.
